trello.name: Document prompt injection support ticket incident in security log
trello.desc: Owner: Hassan. Document the attempted prompt injection ticket properly, including the raw ticket content, what the ticket summarizer actually did, and timestamps. File it in the security log with a severity assessment. Deadline: this week.

trello.name: Harden ticket pipeline against prompt injection and add regression/eval tests
trello.desc: Owner: Wren. Add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser: quoted customer content should be delimited and treated as data when sent to the summarizer, with instruction-like content stripped or neutralized. Turn the reported ticket into a test fixture and add a regression test that feeds this exact ticket through and checks the summary stays clean. Also add an eval that runs a small suite of injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy; fold the eval into this same task. Approved by Grace.

trello.name: Investigate jdoe443 account and password reset email delivery
trello.desc: Owner: Wren. Check whether jdoe443 is a real account and whether password reset emails are not arriving. Check the reset email delivery logs for the last week and follow up on the account. If the account is a burner, close it. If resets are actually broken, that becomes its own incident.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts since May for quarterly access review
trello.desc: Owner: Hassan. Provide Grace with the list of service accounts created since May. This is Hassan's only part in the quarterly access review. Deadline: Thursday.

trello.name: Run quarterly access review
trello.desc: Owner: Grace. Run the quarterly access review herself. Deadline: Friday.
